svg.aria-label: Hold there. Let controlled movement, not a surprise failure, carry the tension.

Exterior close enough to understand the remaining gap. Gantry's damaged systems stay inactive. Kaveri approaches the verified port; keep both hull identities clear and do not add a second docking arrangement for this view.

g.text: Holding here for the port check.

svg.aria-label: Leila and Tomas concentrate on their different parts of the same operation. Neither explains basic flight controls to the competent captain.

g.text: That's the port we checked. Approach

svg.aria-label: The ships connected, their bulk suddenly close. Both coast without thrust; the transfer spaces are in freefall. The moment is quiet rather than triumphant. Pressure and seal checks occur before the following page's opening. The short rigid sealed connector joins the existing side collars with the ships facing opposite directions.
